answer_text:
## 🏥 Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist — **wakehealth.edu**

**[wakehealth.edu](https://www.wakehealth.edu)** is the official website of **Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist**, a major academic medical system based in Winston-Salem, North Carolina. Here's an overview of what the site and organization offer:

---

### 🏨 Medical Center & Patient Care
Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist Medical Center offers expert medical care and advanced treatments in Winston-Salem, NC. Some of their most frequently searched specialties include:
Comprehensive Cancer Center, Heart and Vascular Center, Orthopaedic Services, Neurology and Neurosurgery, Pediatrics, and Primary Care.

- Orthopaedic surgeons and specialists treat every type of orthopaedic condition with advanced techniques and research-based approaches.
- Their experts include more than 150 pediatricians and pediatric surgeons specializing in more than 30 areas, and board-certified primary care providers to help patients and families feel their best.

---

### 🎓 Wake Forest University School of Medicine
Wake Forest University School of Medicine directs the education of nearly 1,900 students and fellows, including physicians, basic scientists, and allied clinical professionals.

- The school has a nationally recognized research program, garnering over $400 million in extramural funding. The PA program is ranked #11 and the Nurse Anesthesia program is ranked #12 in the country.
- The School of Medicine is one of the most selective medical training programs in the nation, encompassing multiple programs including MD, PA Studies, DNP, and biomedical graduate programs.
- With more than 100 accredited and non-accredited residencies and fellowships, Wake Forest University School of Medicine has options for the next step in a medical career.

---

### 💻 Patient Portal — MyAtriumHealth
The portal for Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist patients is now **MyAtriumHealth**. With new features, this portal provides a more convenient experience to access health information. Patients can sign in online or download the free MyAtriumHealth App.

---

### 🤝 Recent News
Hugh Chatham Health has officially joined Atrium Health Wake Forest Baptist.
